title: Simulation-adder states
statement: For a Boolean nondeterministic Turing machine $N$, a simulation-adder state is an augmented state whose underlying state is a simulation state, with a pointer and an array of $h_H(N)+3k$ cells; the pointer ranges from $0$ through $h_H(N)+3k$, and each cell stores a pair of Booleans.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a Boolean nondeterministic Turing machine
